title: Japanese Beef Pilaf
description: A flavorful Japanese-inspired pilaf dish featuring beef and a blend of savory spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until browned, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, then add the onion and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the pepper and cook for another minute, until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Japanese rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the pilaf seasoning, soy sauce, and sugar, then add to the rice mixture and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the cooked beef back into the skillet and stir-fry for another minute, until the beef is coated in the pilaf seasoning mixture.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to a serving dish and serve hot.
Optional: garnish with sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
